query_instruction: Given a teacher question, retrieve relevant teaching reference passages

metrics.recall: mean(relevant returned / all relevant) over answerable cases
metrics.mrr: mean reciprocal first relevant rank over answerable cases
metrics.precision: relevant returned / requested K; macro over answerable cases
metrics.latency: warm search end-to-end incl PG/S3 checks; nearest-rank P50/P95

default_policy: lexical until independent quality review; no threshold tuning in this run
change_reason: Only add executable retriever versions and code provenance; no dataset, label, parameter or threshold changes.
